description: Fetch structured Amazon product data by ASIN via the Oxylabs Web Scraper API — Amazon structured scraping: title, price, currency, rating, reviews count, stock/availability. Calls are synchronous proxying and can take 10-30 seconds. BYOK: _apiKey is "username:password" from the Oxylabs dashboard. Example: oxylabs_amazon_product({ asin: "B08N5WRWNW", domain: "com", _apiKey: "myuser:mypass" })

_apiKey.description: Oxylabs API credentials as "username:password" from the Oxylabs dashboard (https://dashboard.oxylabs.io). Free trial includes up to 2K results.

asin.description: The Amazon product ASIN (10-character ID), e.g. "B08N5WRWNW"

name: oxylabs_amazon_product
title: Oxylabs Amazon Product
